title: a draft launches like any build and its card header ends with (draft); a saved build of the same id wins over a draft, and an invalid draft is rejected with its problems
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and the drafts rows of the other decisions (a just-in-time build is a draft kept in .jitso/drafts/ and validated by code)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7). `jitso launch --build <id>` finds a draft through the same lookup as every build: the draft layer is the last one, so a saved build with the same id wins. A draft is checked with the allowlists like any build and is the one place `status: draft` launches (every other layer needs approved). The card header of a draft ends with ` (draft)` and the dry run prints the card. An invalid draft is `JITSO REJECTED: build "<id>" from draft <path> is invalid here: <problems>`.

files..jitso/briefs/brief.md:
## Goal

Find where the sync entry point of this project is defined and explain in a few sentences how it is wired to the rest of the code.

## Scope

Read only. Do not change any file and do not leave the repository.

## Done when

You can name the file and the line that defines the entry point, and you have checked it by reading the file.

## Report format

One short paragraph with the file path, the line number and a one line summary of what it does.
